text: package contains several functions downloading specific reference datasets: functions provided package take care downloading extracting data. return dataframe like object (DataFrame, Tibble, Simple Features object). can directly used analysis plotting.
code: library(roeference)  # Get a Simple Features object containing the Flemish municipalities and # their boundaries municipalities <- get_vrbg_sf()  # Get a Simple Features object containing the Flemish municipalities and # their boundaries provinces <- get_vrbg_sf(collection = "Refprv")  # Get a Simple Features object containing the protected archaeological # sites in Flanders and their boundaries protected_arch_sites <- get_oe_aanduidingsobjecten(layer = "bes_arch_site") library(ggplot2) library(sf) #> Linking to GEOS 3.14.1, GDAL 3.12.2, PROJ 9.7.1; sf_use_s2() is TRUE  p <- ggplot(protected_arch_sites) +   geom_sf(data = municipalities) +   geom_sf(fill = "red", alpha = 0.8) p
